title: T4 result records
description: The raw result records produced by `go run ./cmd/t4run` and written to results/pilot_results.json. Mirrors harness.Result. This top-level schema validates the whole file (a JSON array); the single-record shape is under $defs/result. These records are the archived input to analysis/make_figures.py.

family.description: Task family the record belongs to.

candidate.description: Candidate id: 'correct' or a mutant id (e.g. m1_unstable_identity).

correct_ref.description: True iff this candidate is the correct reference implementation.

schedule_id.description: The fault schedule this record scored.

seed.description: The schedule seed used for this run.

hidden.description: True iff the schedule is in the hidden (scoring) set.

compile_status.description: Whether the candidate compiled. Shipped candidates always compile.

invariants.description: Per-invariant pass/fail map. Keys are the six shared invariants.

violations.description: Failed invariants in canonical severity order. null (or absent) when nothing was violated.

ok.description: True iff every scored invariant passed for this run.
